name: Deploy PR preview if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'pull_request_synchronize' env: DOCS_SITE_URL: ${{ secrets.DOCS_SITE_URL }} run: | mkdocs gh-deploy --config-file mkdocs.yml --message "Deploy PR ${GITHUB_PR_NUMBER}" --force - name: Clean up PR preview if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_closed' env: DOCS_SITE_URL: ${{ secrets.DOCS_SITE_URL }} run: | mkdocs gh-deploy --config-file mkdocs.yml --delete - name: Post sticky comment with preview URL if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'pull_request_synchronize' env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} DOCS_PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.page_url }} run: | echo "::add-comment::PR Docs Preview: ${DOCS_PREVIEW_URL}" - name: Update sticky comment with changed page links if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'pull_request_synchronize' env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} CHANGED_DOCS_JSON: ${{ steps.get-changed-docs.outputs.changed_docs_json }} run: | python -c " import json import requests from urllib.parse import urljoin changed_docs = json.load(open('${CHANGED_DOCS_JSON}')) pr_number = '${PR_NUMBER}' github_token = '${GITHUB_TOKEN}' base_url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/talmolab/sleap/pulls/${pr_number}/comments' headers = { 'Authorization': f'token {github_token}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json', } for doc_path, doc_url in changed_docs.items(): response = requests.post( base_url, headers=headers, json={ 'body': f'View markdown source' } ) print(response.text) " ```
